entities.summary: Oliver Bjorkstrand is a Danish professional ice hockey player who is a right winger for the Tampa Bay Lightning of the National Hockey League (NHL). Bjorkstrand was selected by the Columbus Blue Jackets in the third round, 89th overall, of the 2013 NHL entry draft. Bjorkstrand is the son of American hockey coach Todd and the brother of Patrick.
